tagline: Real events. Hidden facts. Untold realities.
niche: India-centric documentary: true crime, espionage, political history, untold real events
audience: Hindi-speaking, 18-45, curious about real power, crime, politics, national security
topic_evidence_rule: Only produce scripts on topics with substantial public documentation: court records, published books, newspaper investigations, official government records, or established historical scholarship.

real_figures_policy.historical_or_deceased: render full likeness in channel 2D illustration style
real_figures_policy.currently_serving_heads_of_state: symbolic imagery, silhouettes, settings, maps, documents only - no AI-generated likenesses

cta_style: like/subscribe delivered in the same grave documentary narrator tone, never casual or upbeat
seo_strategy: Hindi curiosity-gap titles under 10 words, keyword-rich 150-200 word Hindi descriptions, 15 hashtags, 30 mixed Hindi/English tags
